inputs.text: This is a fight over who gets to control the narrative. The ACLU and Hoosier Jews for Choice are presenting the judge’s block as religious freedom, while the institutions behind that framing keep the unborn out of sight and cast every abortion limit as oppression. That selective focus doesn’t look neutral—it looks like a coordinated way to steer public attention and make people dismiss the concerns that challenge their agenda.
